product_family: Agentis™ Agentic Commerce Platform for Amazon brands and private label sellers; includes Dynamic Pricing, Advertising Optimization, and Inventory Management modules for Amazon and Walmart.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type I or II)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence or reference found in privacy policy, terms, about pages, or official security documentation.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence or reference found in privacy policy, terms, about pages, or official security documentation.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance (posture/commitment)
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy policy does not name GDPR or cite Article 28. It does include an EEA-scoped section, verbatim: 'This portion of our Privacy Notice only applies to individuals located in the EEA, Switzerland, or the United Kingdom (collectively "EEA") at the time of data collection,' and enumerates data subject rights (Right of Access, Right to Erasure / 'Right to be Forgotten', Right to Data Portability, etc.). This reflects a GDPR-aligned posture, but GDPR is a regulatory obligation, not a third-party certification, and no certification or audit is published on the vendor domain.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. The product is designed for Amazon and retail e-commerce sellers, not healthcare or PHI processing, and is out of scope for HIPAA.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Product handles advertising and pricing data, not direct payment card processing. Vendor likely not in scope for PCI DSS as a service provider.

privacy.ai_training_note: Product uses AI agents to optimize advertising, pricing, and inventory. Privacy policy does not explicitly address whether customer data (product names, prices, advertising performance, inventory levels) is used for model training. Given the agentic AI nature of Agentis platform, this is a material gap in transparency and should be clarified before high-trust deployment. No opt-out mechanism documented.
privacy.data_region: United States (stored and processed in US per privacy policy)

security.name: Physical/Technical/Administrative Safeguards
security.value: Feedvisor claims use of 'reasonable physical, technical and administrative measures to safeguard all personal data.' However, vendor explicitly disclaims 100% security: 'no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.'

security.name: Encryption in Transit/at Rest
security.value: No specific encryption protocols, TLS versions, or at-rest encryption standards documented on public pages.

security.name: Data Retention
security.value: Privacy policy states Feedvisor immediately erases certain PII (first/last name, email, street address). Other personal data (country, city, postal code, items purchased) is immediately anonymized and processed on anonymized/aggregated basis. Specific retention period for non-anonymized operational data not disclosed.

security.name: Incident Response / Data Breach Notification
security.value: No documented incident response process or data breach notification procedures on public pages.

products.name: Agentis™ Agentic Commerce Platform
products.data_scope: Amazon seller account data, product listings, pricing, inventory, advertising performance, competitor intelligence, customer orders (at aggregate level)
products.notes: Primary product. Uses agentic AI to make real-time decisions on advertising bids, prices, and inventory. Integrates with Amazon Sponsored Ads, DSP, AMC, and Walmart. Processes large volumes of customer business data but limited documentation of security controls.

products.name: Dynamic Pricing
products.data_scope: Product catalog, competitor pricing, demand signals, margin targets
products.notes: Standalone module also available. Uses ProductSphere™ technology for dynamic price optimization.

flags: NO_PUBLIC_TRUST_CENTER: Feedvisor does not maintain a publicly visible trust center or security documentation page. Unusual for an enterprise SaaS product handling sensitive business data at scale.
NO_THIRD_PARTY_CERTS: No SOC 2, ISO 27001, or other industry-standard security certifications publicly documented. This gaps enterprise security requirements for many procurement teams.

AI_TRAINING_TRANSPARENCY: Product uses agentic AI but privacy policy does not explicitly address whether customer data is used for model training, fine-tuning, or other AI development. Material gap for AI-sensitive deployments.
ENCRYPTION_NOT_SPECIFIED: Security measures claimed as 'reasonable' but no specifics on encryption standards (TLS 1.3, AES-256, etc.), reducing confidence in actual implementation.
DATA_RETENTION_UNCLEAR: Immediate anonymization claimed for some PII, but retention timeline for operational data (pricing history, advertising logs, inventory snapshots) not disclosed.
GDPR_POSTURE_ONLY: Vendor acknowledges GDPR obligations but has not pursued independent data protection certifications or DPA templates; GDPR is regulatory minimum, not a certification.

ENTERPRISE_MATURITY_MARKERS: Backed by General Catalyst VC (led $20M Series B, 2017), founded 2012, vendor site states $5B+ GMV optimized annually, but security documentation lags industry practice for this maturity level.
